blocks.rationale: The third trigger turns solely on whether a §151 deduction for Bob is allowable to another taxpayer. The facts expressly negate that condition, so a narrow §63(c)(5) applicability classifier should return Contradiction without importing unrelated standard-deduction calculations.

skill.intent: Determine whether the dependent limitation in §63(c)(5) applies to the individual identified in the current proposition because a §151 deduction for that individual is allowable to another taxpayer.

outputs.description: The current native binary label: Entailment when §63(c)(5)'s prerequisite is satisfied, otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

An exemption of the exemption amount for the taxpayer; and an additional exemption of the exemption amount for the spouse of the taxpayer if a joint return is not made by the taxpayer and his spouse, and if the spouse, for the calendar year in which the taxable year of the taxpayer begins, has no gross income and is not the dependent of another taxpayer.
